additional_info.subject: RE: ID0420063 - DC/Si-D/EE - [MP / R2 170001467] - AC charging stopping suddenly CRM:02699000031
additional_info.body:
Hello
Sakari Harjunpää,
Hope you are doing well.
We have analyzed the charger logs over the period of 2weeks, We could see the charger is having Error Flag,
G_AC_OUTLET_STAT_CODE_MODBUS_ERROR_AC_METER
AC1 Errorcode:5-
2025-04-28T03:33:10.131366+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/d5c5a9a65b21[640]: PLC-Error-Flag 'Outlet_AC1_codes' changed from false - ('AC1 Errorcode:0') to true - ('AC1 Errorcode:5')
This error indicates a communication issue between the PLC and AC meter.
Please plan a site visit to check the meter ethernet connection to the switch and PLC ethernet connections to the switch.
Also please carry a spare tested ethernet cable and AC meter.
AC Meter 3P 65A Direct Modbus TCP MID > 7KM2200-2EA40-1JA1
Additionally, upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 03/20/2025, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
